sections.title: Mindset and Vision
tasks: Affirmations: 'I am building a successful web development agency.'
Affirmations: 'I consistently attract clients who value my skills.'
Visualization: Imagine your agency thriving with happy clients, excellent projects, and steady growth.

sections.title: Daily Goals and Priorities
tasks: Review Your Plan: Short-term and long-term goals.
Set Your Top 3 Priorities: E.g., portfolio work, client outreach, content sharing.

sections.title: Outreach and Networking Plan
tasks: Connect: Identify one platform or community to find potential clients.
Engage: Comment, message, or post to build visibility and relationships.
Follow Up: Check in with anyone you reached out to previously.

sections.title: Skill Development & Portfolio Building
tasks: Learn or Improve a Skill: Spend time on tutorials or resources.
Portfolio Work: Add or refine one small project for your portfolio.

sections.title: Marketing Focus
tasks: Update Your Website: Ensure it's polished and user-friendly.
Content Creation: Plan or write a blog post, share a tip, or make a short video.

sections.title: Reflection and Motivation
tasks: Write down 1 thing you're grateful for.
Write down 1 thing you will achieve today.
